integrity: Finite enumeration is exhaustive under a proved prime-523 cutoff, and independently reconstructed prime signatures and matching tuples are reproduced by supplied standalone Python and complete CSV.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification at maximum factorial index 527 only; no general formula at larger maxima or asymptotic claim. The motivating full 2026 manuscript was inspected; historical priority against older unindexed equivalents is not independently settled.
title: Exact multiplicities of the six-factorial square witnesses at the first Erdős–Graham boundary
